extracted.intended_audience: GitHub repository contributors, collaborators, and organization members who create or manage pull requests
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step guidance and policy notes for requesting code reviews on a GitHub pull request, including who may request reviewers, how suggested reviewers are chosen, team-review behavior, and re-request/merge considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of multiple reviewers and team review requests
rubrics_metrics.description: The ability to add multiple pull request reviewers or request reviews from teams is available in public repositories with GitHub Free for organizations and legacy per-repository billing plans, and in public and private repositories with GitHub Team, GitHub Enterprise Server, and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a feature/plan constraint — whether you can add multiple reviewers or request teams depends on the repository type and your organization's GitHub plan. See GitHub's plans for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who can assign pull request reviews (personal-account repos)
rubrics_metrics.description: Owners and collaborators on a repository owned by a personal account can assign pull request reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For repositories belonging to a personal account, assignment power is limited to the owner and named collaborators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who can assign pull request reviews (organization-account repos)
rubrics_metrics.description: Organization members with triage permissions can also assign a reviewer for a pull request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organization membership plus appropriate repository role (triage) grants the ability to assign reviewers; check repository roles for organization-specific behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write access required to assign a reviewer
rubrics_metrics.description: To assign a reviewer to a pull request, you will need write access to the repository.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have write access, you can assign anyone who has read access to the repository as a reviewer. See Repository roles for an organization for details on access levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization members with write access can request any person or team with read access
rubrics_metrics.description: Organization members with write access can also assign a pull request review to any person or team with read access to a repository.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The requested reviewer or team will receive a notification that you asked them to review. If you request a review from a team and code review assignment is enabled, specific members will be requested and the team will be removed as a reviewer. See Managing code review settings for your team.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction: pull request authors cannot always request reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Pull request authors can't request reviews unless they are either a repository owner or collaborator with write access to the repository.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an important permission restriction — authors lacking owner/collaborator write access cannot use the request-review feature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suggested reviewers are based on git blame data
rubrics_metrics.description: You can request a review from either a suggested or specific person. Suggested reviewers are based on git blame data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The UI surfaces likely reviewers by analyzing git blame history; you may choose a suggested reviewer or explicitly pick someone else.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other people with read access may still review despite requests
rubrics_metrics.description: If you request a review, other people with read access to the repository can still review your pull request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requesting a reviewer does not restrict who may review; it is an explicit ask, not an exclusive assignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: You can re-request a reviewer after making changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Once someone has reviewed your pull request and you've made the necessary changes, you can re-request review from the same reviewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Reviewers area in the right sidebar to re-request — this signals the reviewer that changes have been made and another look is desired.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merging can proceed if requested reviewer doesn't submit review and mergeability met
rubrics_metrics.description: If the requested reviewer does not submit a review, and the pull request meets the repository's mergeability requirements, you can still merge the pull request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A requested-but-unsubmitted review does not block merge by itself — repository merge rules (e.g., required reviews, status checks) determine mergeability.

rubrics_metrics.name: UI steps to request a review from a person or team
rubrics_metrics.description: Under your repository name, click Pull requests. In the list of pull requests, click the pull request that you'd like to ask a specific person or a team to review. To request a review from a suggested person under Reviewers, next to their username, click Request. Optionally, to request a review from someone other than a suggested person, click Reviewers. If you know the name of the person or team you'd like a review from, type the username of the person or the name of the team you're asking to review your changes. Click their team name or username to request a review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow these UI actions exactly to make a reviewer request; the page lists the sequence of clicks and the Reviewers input behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: UI step to re-request a review from a reviewer
rubrics_metrics.description: After your pull request is reviewed and you've made the necessary changes, you can ask a reviewer to re-review your pull request. Navigate to Reviewers in the right sidebar and click next to the reviewer's name whose review you'd like.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes the specific UI control for re-requesting an individual's review after changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requesting a review from GitHub Copilot
rubrics_metrics.description: You can also request that Copilot reviews your code and provides feedback and suggested changes on your work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Using GitHub Copilot code review for details; this is an alternative automated-review option rather than a human reviewer.
